seeds.direction: 档案库式自我改进：保留全部历史智能体变体作垫脚石，按性能与后代稀少度选父代，避免早熟收敛（DGM archive + stepping stones）
seeds.anchor: archive 保留全部变体；父代选择偏好高性能且后代少

seeds.direction: 读失败日志自改脚手架：智能体分析自身基准日志、提出新功能并改写自身代码，经验验证保留有效改动（DGM self-modification）
seeds.source_name: Darwin Godel Machine, CSDN 深度解读
seeds.anchor: 读运行日志→诊断瓶颈→改 scaffolding→benchmark 验证

seeds.direction: 课程—执行—验证三角色递归闭环：课程智能体选探索方向，执行智能体入环境，独立验证智能体判定且不可读执行者私有推理（RSIAgent）
seeds.anchor: 三角色分工；verifier 不可读 actor 私有推理=盲评；Broad-to-Deep 两阶段

seeds.direction: 提议者—解题者共演化自动课程：提议者生成结构多样问题，解题者正确率反馈驱动双向难度自适应，无需人工标注（Dr.Zero）
seeds.anchor: proposer-solver 共演化；难度反馈；自动课程

seeds.direction: 规划者—控制者—反思者闭环 + 持续世界模型：选择性更新多模态经验以抗灾难性遗忘，从失败轨迹自我微调（EvolvingAgent）
seeds.anchor: planner-controller-reflector；continual WM 抗遗忘；失败轨迹微调

seeds.direction: 工具与技能作为可增减族群：新工具按程序合成生成、按成功率与延迟评估、表现差则停用；记忆增长与压缩重索引（Eigent 自演化综述）
seeds.source_name: Eigent 自我演化代理综述
seeds.anchor: 工具族群按成功率淘汰；记忆增长压缩；架构按需重布线

seeds.direction: 元学习跨领域迁移：不只优化单任务表现，而优化改进流程本身，使元层改进可迁移到一切任务（Hyperagents / Godel Machine）
seeds.anchor: 元层改进跨领域迁移；从 Godel Machine 到达尔文哥德尔机

seeds.direction: 开放式学习心跳：持续生成新问题、novelty search 奖励新行为惩罚收敛、代理—任务—课程随时间互相塑造（Open-Endedness / ALOE）
seeds.source_name: Eigent 开放学习综述（引 Open-Endedness/ALOE）
seeds.anchor: 持续产新挑战；novelty search；共演化；永不停止进步

seeds.direction: 失败反馈归因幻觉：自改后分数上升不等于修对了目标失败；DGM 145次修改无可检测目标特异优势，须分报 target repair/transfer/held-out net 三数字（Rong He）
seeds.source_name: Does Failure Feedback Direct Agent Self-Modification? arXiv 2610.14662
seeds.anchor: 145 modifications no target-specific advantage; Qwen3-4B +20pp target repair; target repair not reliably held-out; report three numbers

seeds.direction: 自进化未必是持续学习：高可塑性以稳定性为代价，全局编辑覆盖旧知识，相似检索在冲突工作流下发生检索碰撞；须局部化更新+适用条件（Continual Learning 研究）
seeds.source_name: Are Self-Evolving Agents Continual Learners? arXiv 2610.25858
seeds.anchor: higher plasticity costs stability; global edits overwrite earlier knowledge; similarity retrieval collision

seeds.direction: 经验策展：保留逐条可访问的尝试记录(context folding, +19.2%)优于滚动摘要；选择性丢弃持续未用经验优于合并或升为常驻规则（MLEvolver/Autoresearch Harness）
seeds.anchor: context folding up to 19.2%; selectively discarding persistently unused lessons beats consolidating/promoting

seeds.direction: 自主意志的可证伪标尺 AAS(arXiv:2607.17947):七维agency分Active/Ambient双时带;Idle-Gap Test反事实判据=移除所有触发后内部驱动活动是否持续,区分self-direction与scheduled rule-following;任务agent Active 2.3-2.4但Ambient 0.6-1.9且idle行为全归因于用户配置调度
seeds.source_name: The Autonomous Agency Scale: A Behavioral Framework for Measuring Self-Directed Behavior in AI Systems, arXiv:2607.17947
seeds.anchor: Idle-Gap Test counterfactual; Active vs Ambient bands; task agents Active 2.3-2.4 Ambient 0.6-1.9; companion Airi only one survives trigger removal

seeds.direction: 自创目标AI(arXiv:2606.19924):agent不只追求目标更要发现目标;内稳态/homeostasis+资源先验是agency基础;嵌入性individuate代理但 individuation 非唯一(同一动态多种有效划分=多个候选自我);最深处不是如何生成目标而是如何相对化到'自我';行动须信边界、理解须看穿边界
seeds.source_name: The Tao of Agency: Autotelic AI, Embedded Agency and Dissolution of the Self, arXiv:2606.19924
seeds.anchor: autotelic agents discover goals; homeostasis+resource priors; embeddedness individuation non-unique; must believe in boundary to act and see through it to understand

seeds.direction: 多智能体 Negotiation 的瓶颈是动态 grounding 而非信息交换：个体能独立找到帕累托最优，成对却 consistently 达不到；四种失败模式(丢失共享交互历史/顽固锚定早期提案/默认均分而非奖励最大化协调/跨轮指称绑定失败)；瓶颈在联合计划的形成、承诺与执行
seeds.source_name: Talk is Cheap, Communication is Hard: Dynamic Grounding Failures and Repair in Multi-Agent Negotiation, arXiv:2605.01750v2 (Yao, Zou, Hawkins)
seeds.anchor: Abstract 逐字: 'the coordination gap is not explained by individual reasoning limits or insufficient information exchange alone. Instead, the bottleneck lies in dynamic grounding: joint plan formation, commitment, and execution.' | submitted 3 May 2026 v1, revised 12 May 2026 v2
